headline: Ashok Leyland appoints Venkatesan Venkataraman as director
summary: Ashok Leyland's Board appointed Venkatesan Venkataraman as an Additional Director (Non-Executive Non-Independent), effective November 14, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. He is currently President of Hinduja Automotive Limited.

headline: Sudal Industries Q2FY27: Net profit at ₹9.09 lakh
summary: Sudal Industries reported a net profit of ₹9.09 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹65.24 lakh in Q2FY26, while revenue from operations rose 26.4% YoY to ₹5,684.74 lakh.

headline: Gujarat Themis Biosyn company secretary Gawankar resigns
summary: Vineet Gawankar has resigned as company secretary and compliance officer of Gujarat Themis Biosyn, effective close of business on November 30, 2026. He tendered the resignation to pursue opportunities outside the organisation.

headline: Kothari Industrial Q2FY27 results: net loss widens
summary: Kothari Industrial Corporation reported a standalone net loss of ₹1,319.09 lakhs for Q2FY27, wider than ₹604.05 lakhs a year ago, as revenue from operations rose to ₹5,673.25 lakhs.

headline: Sanchay Finvest reports no fund deviation for Q2FY27
summary: Sanchay Finvest Limited reported no deviation in use of preferential issue proceeds for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Funds of 4,85,00,000 lakhs were raised on February 9, 2026, and the filing records no variation in their use.

headline: Punctual Trading appoints Shah & Mantri as statutory auditor
summary: Punctual Trading appointed Shah & Mantri, Chartered Accountants, as statutory auditors effective November 14, 2026. The appointment is subject to member approval and auditor independence requirements. The Board approved it on November 14, 2026.

headline: Savera Industries Q2FY27 results and expansion moves
summary: Savera Industries posted Q2FY27 revenue of ₹2,923.24 lakh and net profit of ₹340.21 lakh, while approving restaurant acquisitions, a Sri Lanka franchise, and a Water Factory shutdown.

headline: Punctual Trading approves RTA change to Purva Sharegistry
summary: Punctual Trading's board approved replacing MUFG Intime India Private Limited with Purva Sharegistry India Pvt. Ltd as RTA on November 14, 2026. MUFG Intime stays on until data transition and NSDL and CDSL confirmations are complete.

headline: Punctual Trading statutory auditor SVP & Associates resigns
summary: SVP & Associates, statutory auditors of Punctual Trading Limited, resigned effective November 14, 2026. The reasons are set out in its enclosed resignation letter. The filing marks director-related disclosures not applicable.

headline: Aditya Ispat Q2FY27 net loss widens to ₹132.63 lakh
summary: Aditya Ispat Limited posted a net loss of ₹132.63 lakh for Q2FY27, against ₹96.94 lakh a year earlier, as revenue fell to ₹526.41 lakh. A non-alloy steel business transfer is expected to complete on or before December 31, 2026.

headline: JD Cables H1FY27 total income up 38.25% to ₹167.89 crore
summary: JD Cables posted H1FY27 total income of ₹167.89 crore, up 38.25% YoY, with net profit of ₹12.29 crore. The company proposes to raise up to ₹100 crore via QIP and/or preferential issue, subject to approvals.

headline: Signet Industries H1FY27 profit jumps 276% to ₹15.61 crore
summary: Signet Industries reported a 276% YoY rise in H1FY27 net profit to ₹15.61 crore, driven by a 40% surge in manufacturing revenue and improved cash flows.

headline: Max Estates launches ₹4,000 crore luxury project in Gurugram
summary: Max Estates Limited launches 'The Bungalows' in Gurugram with a GDV of ₹4,000 crore. The project features 243 privacy-led residences across two towers.

headline: Boston Commerce postpones board meet to Nov 19
summary: Boston Commerce Limited has postponed its board meeting from November 15 to November 19, 2026, to finalize Q1 and Q2 FY27 results due to pending financial deliberations.

headline: BN Agrochem board approves ₹500 Cr loan from AAG Capital
summary: BN Agrochem Ltd board approved material related party transactions, including a ₹500 crore borrowing limit from AAG Capital and ₹750 crore loans to allied entities.

symbol: Majestic Research Services and Solutions Limited
stock_name: Majestic Research Services and Solutions Limited
headline: Majestic Research posts ₹6.2 lakh H1FY26 loss
summary: Majestic Research Services & Solutions reported a net loss of ₹6.20 lakh for H1FY26 with zero revenue. Auditors issued a disclaimer of conclusion citing missing payment vouchers.

headline: Motisons Jewellers Q2FY27 Results
summary: Motisons Jewellers reported a decline in quarterly net profit to ₹1,215.54 lakh despite revenue growth. H1 profit also fell YoY, reflecting margin pressures.

headline: Jaro Education Q2FY27: PAT up 9% YoY
summary: Jaro Education reported a 9% YoY rise in net profit to ₹1,854 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 9% to ₹8,774 lakh, with EBITDA margin at 32%.

headline: Expleo Solutions Q2FY27 Results: Net Profit Down 8.4%
summary: Expleo Solutions reported consolidated net profit of ₹363.97 million for Q2FY27, down 8.4% YoY. Revenue rose 3.5% to ₹2,926.40 million.

headline: CCL International posts Q2FY27 loss
summary: CCL International reported a net loss of ₹110.93 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from ₹56.26 lakh in the year-ago period. Revenue from operations declined 38.8% YoY to ₹319.84 lakh.

headline: Vikram Solar Q2FY27: PAT falls 95% YoY
summary: Vikram Solar reported a sharp decline in Q2FY27 profits due to margin pressure. EBITDA fell 57% YoY as revenue dipped 2.9% despite strong order book growth.

headline: Shree TNB Polymers posts ₹2.58 crore PAT in H1FY27
summary: Shree TNB Polymers reported a half-year profit of ₹2.58 crore with 8.8% EBITDA margins. The company highlights strong order inflows and new capacity expansions post-listing.

headline: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Q2FY27 Results
summary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels reported a 15% YoY rise in Q2FY27 revenue to ₹181.03 crore. However, net profit declined 9.8% to ₹14.64 crore due to higher finance costs.

headline: CWD Ltd H1FY27: Revenue up 46%, PAT down 41%
summary: CWD Limited reported 46% revenue growth to ₹59.96 crore in H1FY27. However, EBITDA margins contracted 564 bps, leading to a 41% decline in net profit.

headline: Peninsula Land signs redevelopment deal in Mumbai
summary: Peninsula Land Limited entered a development agreement for the joint redevelopment of 144 residential units at Andheri West, Mumbai, with two housing societies.

headline: Ajanta Soya Q2FY27 results: Profit dips to ₹1.01 lakh
summary: Ajanta Soya Limited reported a standalone net profit of ₹1.01 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹5.27 lakh in the year-ago quarter, despite revenue rising 11.6% YoY.

headline: McLeod Russel posts Q2FY27 results; Calcom, KNR, Satya report
summary: McLeod Russel India filed Q2FY27 results. Calcom Vision revenue rose 39% YoY. KNR Constructions posted massive standalone profit jump. Satya MicroCapital reported a net loss.

headline: Themis Medicare Q2FY27: EBITDA turns positive
summary: Themis Medicare reported a return to operating profitability in Q2FY27 with EBITDA of ₹5.58 crore. Revenue grew 15.1% YoY to ₹89.74 crore, driven by a 71% rebound in API business.

headline: Zensar EVP Chaitanya Rajebahadur resigns
summary: Zensar Technologies confirmed the resignation of Executive Vice President and Global Leader Chaitanya Rajebahadur, effective November 15, 2026. The departure is due to personal reasons.

headline: Auto Pins Q2FY27: Revenue up 39%, profit dips
summary: Auto Pins India reported a 39.4% YoY rise in Q2FY27 revenue to ₹1,027.26 lakh. However, net profit after tax declined 17.3% YoY to ₹2.43 lakh.

headline: Jindal Supreme Q2FY27 PAT jumps 132% to ₹991 lakh
summary: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited reported a 132% YoY rise in Q2FY27 PAT to ₹991 lakh, driven by 36% revenue growth and margin expansion.
